records.title: ClusterFusion++: Expanding Cluster-Level Fusion to Full Transformer-Block Decoding
records.reason: ClusterFusion++ fuses a full Transformer decoder block (LayerNorm, QKV, RoPE, decode attention, MLP) into cluster-level CUDA kernels with CUDA-Graph execution, cutting decoding latency on Pythia models; a direct LLM decoding kernel contribution.

records.title: Learning-Based Collaborative MEC for LLM Inference with Soft-Deadline Awareness via Transformer-Enhanced PPO
records.reason: Proposes Transformer-enhanced PPO collaboration among MEC servers that schedules LLM inference tasks under soft deadlines with limited deadline extensions; the contribution targets LLM inference scheduling and QoS at the edge.

records.title: Total Cost of Agency: Exact Attribution of Memory Injection Cost in Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
records.reason: Total Cost of Agency only decomposes and attributes memory-injection token costs in multi-agent LLM workflows for observability; it measures inference cost but proposes no serving, memory, or decoding optimization.

records.title: Distributed Inference of Large Language Models on Edge Devices
records.reason: Presents a distributed architecture that runs LLM inference across local-network edge devices (mobile phones) and reports up to 74% lower per-token inference time at four nodes; direct distributed edge inference contribution.

records.title: Can persistent homology whiten Transformer-based black-box models? A case study on BERT compression
records.reason: OBCE uses persistent homology of neuron outputs to rank and remove BERT parameters, compressing BERT Base/Large by roughly half for deployment on resource-constrained devices; a model compression method aimed at cheaper inference.

records.title: Revisiting Funnel Transformers for Modern LLM Architectures with Comprehensive Ablations in Training and Inference Configurations
records.reason: Re-evaluates Funnel Transformer representation compression in Gemma2 with training and inference configuration ablations; mainly an architecture study showing funneling bottlenecks, not a deployable inference system technique.

records.title: GPEmu: A GPU Emulator for Faster and Cheaper Prototyping and Evaluation of Deep Learning System Research
records.reason: GPEmu emulates GPUs (time, memory, distributed and sharing support) to prototype deep learning systems research without real GPUs; a useful systems-research tool but not specific to LLM inference serving or execution.

records.title: ReTern: Exploiting Natural Redundancy and Sign Transformations for Enhanced Fault Tolerance in Compute-in-Memory-Based Ternary LLMs
records.reason: ReTern improves fault tolerance of ternary LLMs deployed on compute-in-memory accelerators via fault-aware sign transformations and bit-cell reprogramming; hardware-level work for efficient ternary LLM inference.

records.title: Native Reasoning Models: Training Language Models to Reason on Unverifiable Data
records.reason: Native Reasoning Training trains language models to reason on unverifiable data with self-generated traces; a training paradigm for reasoning capability with no inference-system mechanism or efficiency contribution.

records.title: Obscura: Concealing Recomputation Overhead in Training of Large Language Models with Bubble-filling Pipeline Transformation
records.reason: Obscura hides activation-recomputation overhead inside pipeline-parallel bubbles to speed up LLM training throughput on Llama-2/GPT-3; training-only acceleration with no inference application stated.

records.title: SwFormer: Enabling Faster Foundation Models on New Sunway Supercomputer via Holistic Kernel Tiling and Scheduling
records.reason: SwFormer accelerates foundation models on the Sunway supercomputer via intra-op kernel tiling and inter-op scheduling, but evaluation is end-to-end GPT-3 training speedups; inference benefit is not demonstrated in the abstract.

records.title: UCCI: Calibrated Uncertainty for Cost-Optimal LLM Cascade Routing
records.reason: UCCI is a calibration-first LLM cascade router that maps token-level margin uncertainty to per-query error probability and picks escalation thresholds by constrained inference-cost minimization on a production workload; direct inference cost optimization.

records.title: Conformal LLM Routing with Distribution-Free Safety Guarantees
records.reason: Adapts conformal gating to LLM routing between Mixtral-8x7B and GPT-4 with a guaranteed violation rate among queries sent to the cheaper model; a routing method whose explicit objective is reducing inference cost safely.

records.title: DLLM-Searcher: Adapting Diffusion Language Model for Efficient Search Agents
records.reason: DLLM-Searcher adapts diffusion LLMs' parallel decoding to ReAct search agents, but the primary aim is restoring agent reasoning and tool-calling ability; the inference-efficiency gain is secondary to the agent application.

records.title: Adaptive Scheduling of Multimodal Large Language Model in Intelligent Edge Computing
records.reason: Decouples MLLM encoders from the LLM across heterogeneous edge devices and adaptively schedules multimodal inference to cut transmission latency and privacy risk; direct edge inference scheduling for MLLMs.

records.title: Asteria: Semantic-Aware Cross-Region Caching for Agentic LLM Tool Access
records.reason: Asteria/Cortex is a cross-region semantic caching architecture for LLM agent tool access, with semantic elements and a retrieval index carrying latency and cost metadata; a caching system reducing LLM workflow latency and cost.

records.title: Efficient Algorithms for Leveraging LLMs for Generative and Predictive Recommender Systems
records.reason: A tutorial on LLM optimizations (quantization, pruning, GPU kernels) for LinkedIn recommender systems; the main purpose is the recommender application and the format is a tutorial, so the inference-system contribution is indirect.

records.title: Dora: QoE-Aware Hybrid Parallelism for Distributed Edge AI
records.reason: Dora plans QoE-aware hybrid (data and pipeline) parallelism for distributed edge AI inference under runtime dynamics and latency requirements; direct distributed inference execution planning.

records.title: Differentially Private Model Compression
records.reason: Initiates differentially private model compression and reaches 50% sparsity on BERT, but the novelty centers on privacy guarantees during fine-tuning rather than an inference execution or serving mechanism.

records.title: Enabling Real-Time AI at the Edge: A Comparative Analysis of Latency and Accuracy in Sub-3B Parameter Models
records.reason: Comparative measurement of three 4-bit GGUF small models under llama.cpp in a simulated mobile setting (latency versus reasoning trade-offs); an evaluation study with no new inference technique.

records.title: Fearless Concurrency on the GPU
records.reason: cuTile Rust extends Rust ownership to tile-based GPU kernel authoring with data-race freedom guarantees; a general GPU programming system, not an LLM inference kernel or serving contribution.

records.title: FastAFD: When Does Attention-FFN Disaggregation Pay on Rack-Scale NVLink?
records.reason: FastAFD builds an attention-FFN disaggregated MoE serving engine for GB200 NVL72 that overlaps MoE and attention microbatches and beats tuned vLLM wide expert parallelism on decode throughput; direct serving-system contribution.

records.title: Cicada: A Pipeline-Efficient Approach to Serverless Inference with Decoupled Management
records.reason: Cicada attacks serverless inference cold starts with pipelined model loading (MiniLoader, decoupled weight loading) coordinating compute, storage and scheduling; direct inference serving infrastructure.

records.title: AgentMath: Empowering Mathematical Reasoning for Large Language Models via Tool-Augmented Agent
records.reason: AgentMath builds tool-augmented SFT data and agentic RL so LLMs solve complex mathematics with code interpreters; a reasoning-capability framework with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Representational Collapse in Multi-Agent LLM Committees: Measurement and Diversity-Aware Consensus
records.reason: Measures representational collapse in multi-agent LLM committees and adds a diversity-weighted consensus protocol with lower token cost; primarily a capability/measurement study of agent voting, not an inference system.

records.title: Do All Individual Layers Help? an Empirical Study of Task-Interfering Layers in Vision-Language Models
records.reason: Empirical study of task-interfering layers in vision-language models via per-layer interventions; an analysis of model behavior with no compression, serving, or inference-efficiency method proposed.

records.title: RouteProfile: Graph-Based Profiling for Cold-Start LLM Routing
records.reason: RouteProfile builds graph-based profiles of newly released LLMs from public signals so routers can cold-start model selection; it supports LLM routing but contributes profiling, not a serving or cost-optimization mechanism.

records.title: REEF: Representation Encoding Fingerprints for Large Language Models
records.reason: REEF fingerprints whether a suspect LLM derives from a victim model using representation similarity for IP protection; model-provenance detection with no inference efficiency or systems content.

records.title: 2-D SSM: A General Spatial Layer for Visual Transformers
records.reason: Proposes a 2-D state-space layer with efficient parameterization and accelerated computation inserted into Vision Transformers; an efficient vision architecture component, not an LLM inference system contribution.

records.title: Efficient Streaming LLM for Speech Recognition
records.reason: SpeechLLM-XL uses chunked limited-window attention for linear-scaling streaming speech recognition; the efficiency technique is real but the target is a speech-recognition application model, not LLM serving.

records.title: Multimodal Clinical Trial Outcome Prediction with Large Language Models
records.reason: Title itself states the work predicts multimodal clinical trial outcomes with LLMs, a medical outcome-prediction application; no inference-system technique is indicated in the title.

records.title: More Than Just Functional: LLM-as-a-Critique for Efficient Code Generation
records.reason: Uses a prompted LLM as an efficiency critique over the AST of generated code so code LLMs emit faster-running programs; the efficiency concerned is the generated code's runtime, not the LLM's inference system.

records.title: NEST: Nested Event Stream Transformer for Sequences of Multisets
records.reason: NEST is a nested event-stream Transformer architecture for sequences of multisets such as EHR encounters; a domain sequence-modeling architecture with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Predictive Divergence Masks for LLM RL
records.reason: Predictive Divergence Masks change token masking criteria in PPO-style reinforcement learning for LLMs; a training-algorithm contribution with no inference application.

records.title: Bayesian Entropy-based Reordering for Calibrated Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: BayesER is a post-hoc Bayesian decoding framework that orders token commitment in masked diffusion language models by predictive entropy; decoding-time, but aimed at calibration of generation rather than inference efficiency or serving.

records.title: Mixtures of Experts for Scaling up Neural Networks in Order Execution
records.reason: Applies mixture-of-experts RL agents with spectral-clustering specialization to optimal order execution on NASDAQ Amazon stock data; a financial trading application, confirmed by the abstract.

records.title: Cookbook: A framework for improving LLM generative abilities via programmatic data generating templates
records.reason: Cookbook programmatically generates synthetic instruction data to fine-tune LLM generative abilities; a training-data construction framework with no inference-system content.

records.title: Joint Partitioning and Placement of Foundation Models for Real-Time Edge AI
records.reason: Formalizes joint layer partitioning and placement of foundation models across heterogeneous edge infrastructure as runtime-resolved optimization under latency and utilization constraints; direct distributed inference orchestration.

records.title: Bridging Brains and Models: MoE-Based Functional Lesions for Simulating and Rehabilitating Aphasia
records.reason: Lesions components of an MoE language model to simulate aphasia subtypes and validates outputs against patient speech; a neuroscience/cognitive-modeling study, not an inference contribution.

records.title: SCFormer: Structured Channel-wise Transformer with Cumulative Historical State for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: SCFormer adds temporal constraints and HiPPO historical state to a channel-wise Transformer for multivariate time-series forecasting; a forecasting architecture for a non-LLM application.

records.title: UniFormer: Unified and Efficient Transformer for Reasoning Across General and Custom Computing
records.reason: UniFormer designs a unified efficient Transformer deployable across general and custom (FPGA/ASIC) computing; hardware-deployment oriented architecture work, but generic across models rather than an LLM inference system.

records.title: Correct, Concise and Complete: Multi-stage Training For Adaptive Reasoning
records.reason: Multi-stage SFT plus RL with an adaptive length penalty teaches adaptive reasoning and reduces overthinking; a training recipe for reasoning quality, not an inference-system mechanism.

records.title: Personalize-then-Store: Benchmarking and Learning Personalized Memory for Long-horizon Agents
records.reason: PerMemBench benchmarks personalized long-term memory for LLM agents and studies session-level storage policies; relevant to agent memory cost, but the contribution is a benchmark and policy study, not an inference system.

records.title: Question-guided Visual Compression with Memory Feedback for Long-Term Video Understanding
records.reason: QViC-MF compresses long-video frames with question guidance and memory feedback for video understanding; visual compression serves a perception task and its inference-system contribution is indirect.

records.title: Context Pruning for Coding Agents via Multi-Rubric Latent Reasoning
records.reason: LaMR prunes repository context for coding agents using latent multi-rubric relevance, reducing agent token budgets; context management for an agent application rather than an inference serving or decoding technique.

records.title: ServeLearnBench: How Well Can Agents Self-Improve from Serving Experience?
records.reason: ServeLearnBench is a benchmark for how well LLM agents self-improve from serving experience in evolving environments; capability evaluation with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Convergent Stochastic Training of Multi-Headed Attention and Understanding LoRA
records.reason: Proves convergence/trainability of stochastic training for multi-head attention and LoRA via Poincare inequalities; optimization theory for training, with no inference application.

records.title: Isomorphic Pruning for Vision Models
records.reason: Isomorphic Pruning removes heterogeneous substructures (attention heads, convolutions, residuals) in vision models; a structured pruning method, but demonstrated on vision models rather than LLM inference.

records.title: Unveiling the Hidden Structure of Self-Attention via Kernel Principal Component Analysis
records.reason: Derives self-attention from kernel PCA and analyzes the value matrix theoretically; an interpretability/theory account of attention with no system or efficiency contribution.

records.title: Differentiable Sparsity via D-Gating: Simple and Versatile Structured Penalization
records.reason: D-Gating makes structured sparsity differentiable so compact networks can be trained with SGD; a training-side sparsity regularizer whose inference benefit is only via the resulting smaller model.
